finalText:
Build is clean now. The real error was buried under those warnings: `ReferenceError: retries is not defined` in `src/core/settings.js:17`.

The `resolveConfig` function was trying to use a bare `retries` variable that didn't exist. It should have been `env.retries` to pull the value from the config object passed by the caller. I changed line 17 to `maxRetries: env.retries || 3,` so it grabs the value from the environment or falls back to 3.

The 3 warnings stay (deprecated crypto API, unused export, circular import) but those are genuine issues separate from the build-blocking bug. Build finishes in 41.7s with just those warnings, zero errors.
